boundary.material_payload_status: Opaque material parameters remain serialized behind each material record.
boundary.texture_reference_status: No named TXTR identity occurs in the scene system part, including the serialized material roster and payloads.
boundary.package_candidate_status: The three same-package TXTR resources are package-level candidates only; none is statically referenced by identity.
boundary.gpu_part_status: The scene has a separate GPU-memory part, but the static material-to-GPU-resource join is not decoded.
boundary.product_behavior: Show scene node, draw, material slot, and shader-family identity; keep texture owner unresolved and Replace/Revert disabled.

missing_runtime_fields: the loaded stadium instance material-array base
the selected pixel-shader eight-entry texture mapping
the live texture object in each selected material texture record
the guest allocation or resource identity behind each live texture object
best_next_experiment: Use a small instrumented Xenia build or a native-Windows guest debugger that logs one known stadium draw at the renderer handoff without raising a Wine host breakpoint. Capture the material-array base, selected pixel-shader mapping, every live texture-object pointer, and each guest allocation and dimensions. A matching allocation proves an owner; no match falsifies the same-package candidates and identifies the next loader boundary.
